from pathlib import Path

old = json.loads((repo/'docs/performance/task-caller-order-proof-20261008.json').read_text())
script = old['sourceArchive']['run-native.py']
script = script.get('text', script.get('body')) if isinstance(script, dict) else script
script = script.replace('task-caller-order-proof-20261008','exhaust-root-turn-contract-20261008').replace('TASK-CALLER-ORDER-PROOF','EXHAUST-ROOT-TURN-CONTRACT')
(base/'run-native.py').write_text(script)
(base/'native.props').write_text('<Project><PropertyGroup><CopyModOnBuild>false</CopyModOnBuild></PropertyGroup><ItemGroup><Compile Include="'+str(base/'TaskExhaustRootTurn.cs')+'" /></ItemGroup></Project>\n')
executor = repo/'src/Testing/Host/UnattendedTestRunner.Executor.cs'
original = executor.read_bytes()
(base/'original-executor.txt').write_bytes(original)
marker = b'            if (request.ScenarioId is "ZERO-CREDIT-GROWTH-PROOF"'
if original.count(marker) != 1: raise RuntimeError('Executor marker is ambiguous')
route = b'''            if (request.ScenarioId == "EXHAUST-ROOT-TURN-CONTRACT")
            {
                await runner.AssertExhaustRootTurnAsync(combatState, player);
                return Observation(combatEnded: false);
            }
'''
patched = original.replace(marker, route+marker)
executor.write_bytes(patched)
(base/'temporary-executor.txt').write_bytes(patched)
(base/'preparation.json').write_text(json.dumps({'sourceBase':'0e458516','executorOriginalSha256':hashlib.sha256(original).hexdigest(),'executorPatchedSha256':hashlib.sha256(patched).hexdigest()},indent=2)+'\n')
